name: Jászárokszállás (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Jászárokszállás (a blue shield with a figure, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) between the words ÁROKSZÁLLÁSI above and SZABAD JÁSZOK below in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászárokszállás arms with helm, crest and mantling
